findings.statement: Reference r02 to r03 to r04 to r05 shows none selected, Spanish selected and Continue enabled, building placeholder, system Back then selection cleared and Continue disabled; same limited source rule supported by historical 05-08
White background, gray track/disabled, green face/lip, selected blue face/border match at listed sample positions; not a whole-image color claim
Source section header has up arrow and clickable=true; reference lacks arrow and clickable=false
Reference header/cards down 1px, Spanish flag up 1px; source card lip 8px at x400, reference 10px
At x500 source disabled face starts y1056; reference y1048, despite same reported bounds
Reference text solid-ink extents wider; bubble body left border 6px left of source at y320; exact source typeface remains unknown
Reference status/body top shifted up40px, body taller22px; captured three-line breaks match after million/learning, while localized bold, text widths and line spacing differ
Static reference character/pose differ; Back is character chevron TextView versus arrow ImageView; selected RadioButton semantics differ from source LinearLayout
Reference r05 shows right scroll indicator; source08 does not in its PNG; timing persistence unknown
